text:
Maya L: Morning triage — quick check-in. Tickets: 42 open total, 5 P1s (2 backend timeouts, 1 auth failure, 2 billing). Current known issues: embedding pipeline slower for docs >50k tokens (investigating), intermittent email webhook failures for some customers since last deploy. Macros: updated `ack-and-escalate` to include the new SLO link.

Maya L: What I did yesterday: triaged billing noise, deployed patch to error-logging for embeddings. Blockers: need approval on rollback PR for webhook change (PR #4893). Today: pair with Jordi on webhook rollback, Priya to take the auth P1, Sam to run embedding canary.

Jordi K: I can take the webhook rollback — will start review now. Which env do we want to target first, prod or canary?

Maya L: Start canary in us-west first, then prod if green. PR is #4893, needs +1 from eng-sre and ops.

Priya S: Taking the auth P1. Symptoms: auth token validation error for ~10% of requests to /v1/session. Suspect token cache TTL mismatch after last deploy. Need prod auth logs (cannot access until my MFA re-registers at ~08:45). No other blockers from my side.

Sam R: I'll own embedding pipeline canary. Noticed memory OOM on one worker when batch_size > 8 for long docs. I'll try reducing max_batch and enable KV cache TTL adjustment. Will post metrics to #eng-runtime-canary.

Maya L: Thanks. Quick note on macros — to use the new ack flow, run: `/macro ack-and-escalate <ticket>` or see snippet below.

Maya L: ```
/macro ack-and-escalate
Title: Acknowledge & Escalate
Steps:
  1) Add comment: "Ack - investigating — @oncall"
  2) Set priority: P1
  3) Tag: incident=true
  4) Run: /escalate team=eng-sre
Notes: includes link to SLO and the new rollout checklist.
```

Jordi K: Rolled back the webhook change in canary at 08:10 — ops-bot reports: "rollback job started". Monitoring logs for 10m.

ops-bot: rollback job started for service=webhooks, job_id=rb-2024-06-15-01 :white_check_mark:

Jordi K: Canary looks stable for the last 12 minutes, no webhook failures seen. Will open prod rollback ticket if no regressions in next 20m.

Priya S: Re-registered MFA, pulling auth logs now. Found repeated 401s from the token refresh endpoint aligned with a TTL bump in release v1.18. Sending details to #eng-security.

Sam R: Adjusted canary max_batch to 6 and enabled per-request KV cache. Memory no longer spikes; embeddings latency improved ~18%. Will scale canary to 5 nodes after lunch.

Maya L: Great. Action items: 1) Jordi — prepare prod rollback if canary stays green (PR #4893). 2) Priya — follow up with eng-security on TTL rollback or patch. 3) Sam — keep canary scaling and post perf dashboard link. 4) I'll update the triage doc with today's counts and publish the macro tweak.

Maya L: If anyone hits blockers, drop a quick note here and tag @oncall. Otherwise, update this thread when you ack the ticket you picked. :thumbsup:
